component.name: Commando
component.summary: Put an AI agent to work on your desktop

description.p: Commando is a native Linux client for working with an AI agent on local files and terminal tasks. Describe an outcome, follow the action log, and inspect the files in your workspace.
Connect to Ollama, OpenAI, a ChatGPT subscription, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or another OpenAI-compatible service.
